builds.name: Reference: Armor and control
builds.goal: Reference for Poppy: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: An anti-mobility warden who uses walls and dash denial to keep enemies in unfavorable positions. Compare wall-stun reliability and dash denial with physical burst. Shield pickup and passive attack cadence matter; R displacement can remove the target from damage range. Armor and a real Spellblade attack may preserve close fighting windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Poppy: Compare wall-stun reliability and dash denial with physical burst. Shield pickup and passive attack cadence matter; R displacement can remove the target from damage range.

Start with the early core (Iceborn if attack access is useful, otherwise matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and a real Spellblade attack may preserve close fighting windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Do not add another Spellblade item; Thornmail and Randuin are conditional purchases.

The route fails Poppy's stated kit question: Compare wall-stun reliability and dash denial with physical burst. Shield pickup and passive attack cadence matter; R displacement can remove the target from damage range.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Do not add another Spellblade item; Thornmail and Randuin are conditional purchases.
Full cost 14,750 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Iceborn if attack access is useful, otherwise matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Thornmail, Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Begin Casting: Poppy begins charging her hammer for up to [4] seconds, Slowing herself by [15]%.

Release: Poppy smashes the ground, creating a shockwave that deals [200 / 300 / 400 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first champion hit and surrounding enemies, Knocks them Back towards their Nexus, and makes them Untargetable while they fly. The range and Knock Back distance increase with charge duration.

An uncharged swing deals [(200 / 300 / 400 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.5)] physical damage and Knocks Up for [1] seconds.

Passive: Poppy gains [(0.16) × Stat(1)] Armor and [(0.16) × Stat(6)] Magic Resist. This bonus is doubled if Poppy is below [40]% Health.

Active: Poppy gains [40]% Move Speed and projects a field around her for [2] seconds that stops enemy dashes. Enemies who are stopped by the field are Grounded and Slowed by [25]% for [2] seconds and take [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage.

Poppy smashes the ground, dealing [30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [7 / 7.5 / 8 / 8.5 / 9]% max Health physical damage and making the ground unstable. 

The unstable area Slows enemies by [0.2 / 0.23 / 0.26 / 0.29 / 0.32 + (8e-05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] and erupts after [1] second, dealing [30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [7 / 7.5 / 8 / 8.5 / 9]% max Health physical damage again.

Every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=16, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 19, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -2.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds, Poppy's next Attack throws her buckler, gaining [350] range and dealing an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(20 → 180; raw flags preserved)] magic damage. The buckler ricochets off the target, landing nearby. Poppy can pick it up to gain [(characterLevelInterpolation(0.11 → 0.2; raw flags preserved)) × Stat(12)] Shield, and enemies can step on it to destroy it.

The buckler automatically returns to Poppy if it kills the target.

Poppy tackles an enemy, dealing [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and carrying them forward. If Poppy tackles them into terrain, the enemy is Stunned for [1.6 / 1.7 / 1.8 / 1.9 / 2] seconds and take an additional [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.
